Is the Arma Humble Bundle worth it?

I can't imagine why you'd play Arma 1 or 2 over 3, unless you're into Day Z, and even then, there are zombie/survival gametypes on 3 as well. The karts DLC is an April fools joke (context) they decided to actually implement, and isn't really worth mentioning. So I'd consider that bundle to be mostly just buying Arma 3 for $15. The other DLCs are more worthwhile than karts, especially Apex, but not having them won't restrict you much. There will be a few guns you can't pick up and a few helicopters you can't fly, but in both cases there's nothing in the DLCs that fills a role that isn't already pretty much covered by something in the base game, and the fundamental gameplay mechanics each DLC add are always rolled into the base game. Not having Apex will restrict you from playing on some servers, mostly any server playing Tanoa. How much that matters to you depends largely on how much you prefer a tropical island (Tanoa) to Mediterranean island (Altis/Stratis) or any of the third party ones.
